messages:
hui: filing an oddball parity case with the flutter/mobile SDK + devex batcher. embedding dim mismatch in rerank sampleapp. got a 3071-length vector vs expected 3072 after an auth refresh+retry.

hui: minimal repro: sampleapp (flutter) uses devex-batcher v0.6.0-beta which pads to next multiple (batch_size=4). send 3 docs -> pads to 4. force token expiry while batch in-flight. sometimes response has one vector short by 1 float.

hui: flutter snippet:
```dart
final res = await client.embeddings.create(
  model: 'embed-large-3072',
  input: ['a','b','c'], // batcher pads to 4
);
```

hui: truncated response (sanitized):
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[...3072 floats...]},{"embedding":[...3072 floats...]},{"embedding":[...3072 floats...]},{"embedding":[...3071 floats...]}]}
```

hui: logs show: 
[batcher] queued batch id=924 pads=1 pad_index=3
[auth] 401 -> refresh -> retry
[batcher] replaying batch id=924
[client] assembling response for batch id=924

omar: interesting. node/python desktop sampleapps didn't hit this because their helpers snapshot pad metadata earlier. sounds like mobile helper mutates pad flags after enqueue, so retry replays a mutated record.

sanjay: also possible interplay with streaming/partial-chunk assembly. if server streams tokens and last float missing due to chunk boundary + retry, assembly might not catch short vectors. did you see any chunking logs?

hui: no streaming for embeddings but we do multipart transfer on mobile. logs don't show chunk errors, just 200 with array length 4 and final vector length 3071.

ke: immediate mitigations: (1) SDK should validate embedding length against profile/model metadata and surface EmbeddingShapeError with request_id/user-visible message; (2) batcher should deep-clone pad metadata when enqueuing so retries are deterministic; (3) runtime should include top-level embedding_dim + per-item source_index in /v1/embeddings response body so clients can remap reliably.

omar: agree. also add a non-fatal telemetry event when shape mismatch occurs to gather frequency before failing hard.

sanjay: i'll add CI matrix: flutter/node/python x batch_sizes 2..8 x pad_positions head/mid/tail x token-expiry point. include mobile network jitter to simulate chunking.

hui: filed DE-5101: "mobile batcher pad snapshot lost on auth-retry -> 1-float short embedding (3072->3071)" with logs and a small flutter repro. devex-bot created the issue.

devex-bot: created issue DE-5101 and attached repro and PR template.

ke: i'll draft a small patch to mobile batcher to snapshot pad flags at queue-time and add embedding-length validation during assembly. will include a graceful error with suggestion to retry the request.

omar: i'll request eng-runtime to add embedding_dim + request_id in response body. that helps SDKs in low-level languages and mobile clients that prefer defensive checks. cc @eng-runtime.

hui: thanks all. once a canary is available i'll run the flutter sampleapp and share results. will also add a short note in the mobile SDK changelog about the fix.

ke: target canary later today; starting with non-breaking validation only. follow-up runtime change can be rolled after SDKs are patched.

hui: awesome, closing loop here after CI + canary pass. :thumbsup:
